component.name: DLSS 5 for Linux
component.summary: Probe Steam games and install DLSS 5 neural rendering under Proton

description.p: A Linux port of the renodx-dlss-installer. It walks every Steam library, probes each installed game to say whether DLSS 5 can work there, and installs, uninstalls or launches it without you typing a path.

ul.li: optiscaler: for D3D12 games that already ship DLSS (recommended)
reshade: ReShade with the RenoDX DLSS 5 add-on and Streamline
feeder: DLSS5-Feeder for games with no DLSS of their own

description.p: Components are downloaded at run time from their projects' GitHub releases and are not shipped with this application. The neural rendering model is pre-release third-party code: use it in single-player games only, never with anti-cheat.

screenshot.caption: A game with its own DLSS, installed with the optiscaler engine
A game with no DLSS, running DLSS 5 through the feeder engine

description.p: First packaged release: native desktop window, RPM and AppImage builds.
